pages.title: Fridge
pages.text: The Fridge keeps food fresh indefinitely as long as it has power. Food stored inside doesn't age at all while the fridge is powered. It costs $(bold)16 FE per food item per day$(), so one Power Bank can keep it running for a very long time.

pages.title: Using the Fridge
pages.text: Right-click to open the fridge. It has $(bold)54 slots$() — enough for a lot of food! Connect a Power Bank next to it to keep it powered. You'll hear a quiet hum when it's running. If it runs out of power, food starts aging normally again.

pages.title: Tip
pages.text: The fridge only accepts food items. Put it near your crops or kitchen area and stock it up early. A fully solar-powered fridge will keep your food fresh for free — that's a smart, clean solution!
The fridge keeps its energy when you pick it up.
